board: Blue Robotics Bar30 High-Resolution 300m Depth/Pressure Sensor (MS5837-30BA, 4-pin JST-GH: Vin, SCL, SDA, GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The driver follows the TE datasheet: reset, 7-word PROM with the word-0 CRC-4, D1/D2 conversions at OSR 4096, and second-order compensation, and it reproduces the datasheet example (3999.8 mbar, 19.81 C). The sim works the datasheet formula backwards from the PROM registers, and the Bar30 has no pull-ups, so 4.7k pull-ups are declared.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://bluerobotics.com/store/sensors-cameras/sensors/bar30-sensor-r1/ (1 red Vin, 2 green SCL, 3 white SDA, 4 black GND) and https://github.com/bluerobotics/Bar30-Pressure-Sensor/blob/master/BAR30-SENSOR-Schematic.pdf
